newsitem.title: UK: Sears slips on profit warning report.
newsitem.headline: Sears slips on profit warning report.

text.p: Shares in Sears slipped 3p to 8-1/2 in pre-opening trade on Thursday after a report that the UK retailing group was about to issue a profit warning.
The Guardian newspaper said Sears was about tell investors that its profits for the current fiscal year were as much as 20 percent below analysts' forecasts of about 100 million stg.
The report said some institutional investors were planning a campaign to remove chief executive Liam Strong, who has been trying to turn the company round by divesting and restructuring.
No one at Sears was immediately available for comment.
